howItWorks.title: How to Remove Unwanted Objects from Photos
howItWorks.description: Erase anything from your images with our free AI image eraser in just a few simple steps:

step1.title: 1. Upload your image
step1.description:
Drag and drop or select your photo. Supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC formats.

  • Works with landscapes, portraits, product shots, and more

step2.title: 2. Brush or click on unwanted objects
step2.description:
Simply paint over the object, person, text, or blemish you want to remove.

  • Adjust brush size for precision
  • Our AI automatically detects and selects the area

step3.title: 3. Let AI erase and fill
step3.description:
Click Remove – the AI instantly erases the selection and intelligently fills the space with matching surroundings.

  • Preview the result in real time
  • Undo or redo as needed

step4.title: 4. Refine and download
step4.description:
Fine-tune if desired:

  • Re-brush missed spots
  • Restore accidentally removed areas

Download your clean, high-quality image – ready to use.

faq.title: AI Image Eraser FAQs
faq.description: Common questions about our AI image eraser.

q1.question: What image formats are supported?
q1.answer: We support JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC. Best results with clear, high-quality images.

q2.question: Will my edited images have a watermark?
q2.answer: No. All downloads are clean and watermark-free.

q3.question: How good is it at complex removals?
q3.answer: Our AI excels at large objects, people in crowds, and textured backgrounds. For ultra-fine details, use smaller brush strokes.

q4.question: Can I remove multiple objects from one image?
q4.answer: Yes – brush over as many areas as needed before generating.

q5.question: Can I process multiple images at once?
q5.answer: Yes – batch mode lets you upload and erase objects from several photos in one session.

q6.question: Is my data safe?
q6.answer: Yes. Uploaded images are processed securely and automatically deleted after processing. We never use them for training.
